item: previous_session_peaks.last_thread_census: which kernel threads Python did not start existed at the last census (a lower bound in time)
summary: Three of four traced SIGABRTs open on a thread Python never created. The liveness thread now counts /proc/self/task at most once a minute, subtracts the kernel ids threading knows, and keeps the rest by kernel thread name (most numerous first, as many as fit CENSUS_BYTES = 150 serialised bytes, the key included; other_comms counts the names left out). Python thread names are never read. Linux only; elsewhere unavailable with a reason, never 0. The member is the LAST census, so a pool started after it is not in it. Budget: with it the core-dump stack is 589 B (WAL's 2,415 B headroom less 1,826).
